votes.motion: Grant a three-bedroom deed restriction on the primary residence at 833 Flatt Hill Road so a building permit can issue for a three-season porch.
votes.quote: on motion by rudd and second by pir ro, the approval of a three bedroom deed restrict was granted.

votes.motion: Require that PFAS also be included in the well testing for 177 Burrage Street.
votes.quote: on motion by rudd and second by fortin, the board voted to require pfas also be included in the well testing.

votes.motion: Rescind the requirement for a cooktop at 143 Island Road.
votes.quote: motion by pirro and second by fortin. all in favor

votes.motion: Extend the time to repair the downstairs shower leak at 143 Island Road by 60 days.
votes.quote: motion by pirro and second by fortin to extend time to repair for 60 days.

votes.motion: Grant a variance for reduced light in a bedroom at 143 Island Road until the property is unoccupied.

on motion by rudd and second by proctor the meeting was adjourned at 6:00 pm.
